subject: P0: DeepWell latency blast in us-east-az3 — containment & warm-handoff
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@deepwellhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>; support@redwood.ai
Cc: DeepWell SRE <sre@deepwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: High error rate + 5–10s p95 latency in us-east-az3 — urgent

Neha — we’re seeing a sudden spike impacting API traffic from our web tier to your hosted inference in us-east-az3. Symptoms:
- p95 latency jumped from ~300ms to 5–10s starting ~08:52 EDT
- 5xx error rate ~6% for the last 12 minutes, clients seeing timeouts
- Throughput looks steady; it’s latency + error amplification

We’ve already throttled some clients and shifted a subset of traffic to a secondary region (us-east-az1) but the user-facing impact remains material (payments flows failing for ~7% of requests). Can you confirm whether there’s an ongoing AZ degradation, and what containment plan you can enact right now (prefix cache purge, model variant swap, regional warm-handoff)?

Attaching a small sample and a screenshot of your metrics. Please escalate — we’ll need an executive point-of-contact if this becomes cross-region.

Attachments: deepwell_p90-requests-0900-0915.csv, az3-metrics-snapshot.png

— Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of SRE, DeepWell Health
alex.morgan@deepwellhealth.com

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@deepwellhealth.com>; DeepWell SRE <sre@deepwellhealth.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: High error rate + 5–10s p95 latency in us-east-az3 — urgent

Alex — thanks for the quick heads up and the artifacts, we’re on it. Short answers up front:
- We see degraded worker pool health in us-east-az3 (inference queueing + a subset of OOM restarts) for the 08:50–09:10 window.
- Immediate containment: rolling model-variant swap to a lower-memory quantization for AZ3 lanes, and enabling warm-handoff to us-east-az1 for new requests only.
- Exec loop: looping in Hannah (ops lead) and Vivek for prioritization & credits/communications.

Action items we’ve started (status below):
1) Triggered model-variant swap (low-risk, no schema changes) — in progress (expected 3–5m).
2) Enabled prefix-key bypass for your high-throughput routes to avoid KV-cache contention.
3) Started warm-handoff to us-east-az1 for new sessions; existing sessions remain pinned until safe drain.

We’ll send a short update when the p95 drops closer to normal or if we need a full regional drain. I’ll include the runbook snapshot and the contingency checklist in the next update.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>; vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>; marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@deepwellhealth.com>; DeepWell SRE <sre@deepwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: High error rate + 5–10s p95 latency in us-east-az3 — urgent

Status update (09:42):
- Model-variant swap completed across AZ3 worker pool at 09:29 — observed immediate reduction in OOM restarts.
- p95 for DeepWell routes dropped from ~6s -> ~420ms (still above baseline). Error rate down to ~0.9%.
- Warm-handoff to us-east-az1 is actively accepting new sessions; traffic steering at the router shows ~18% spillover.

Next steps (coordinated):
- Continue draining long-lived KV sessions in us-east-az3; expected drain window ~30–45m.
- If p95 > 500ms after 30m, prepare for full regional redirect (authorization needed). Vivek — please advise whether we should trigger the regional redirect now or hold for additional stabilization.
- Marissa — prepare customer-facing comms + a short exec summary; include runbook excerpt (attached).

Attachments: runbook-warm-handoff.pdf

— Hannah (on behalf of the incident bridge)
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@deepwellhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>; neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>; marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; DeepWell SRE <sre@deepwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 13:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: High error rate + 5–10s p95 latency in us-east-az3 — urgent

Thanks for the fast work and the updates. Current customer impact looks limited to a 2–3% residual error/timeout rate on payments (after our mitigations) but we still have a cohort failing intermittently. Two asks from DeepWell:
- Please keep us posted on timeline for full drain of AZ3 and when you’ll flip routing for all sessions (we’d prefer a controlled cut-over overnight if possible).
- We’ll need a short post-incident note with what triggered the OOM cascade, why KV-cache contention surfaced now, and any short-term config changes we should make client-side (timeouts / retry windows).

Also escalating to our CTO; we may ask for a one-time credit because this incident overlapped a business-critical window. If you can provide a preliminary RCA and credit path, that will help the renewal discussion.

Appreciate the transparency.

— Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of SRE, DeepWell Health
